# Encounters Arc 7 — PNJ mineurs

> Fiche groupée des **PNJ mineurs Arc 7** rencontrés en cours de campagne avec **interactions courtes** (pas de fiche individuelle dédiée pour préserver lisibilité). Triés par chapitre canon.

## Arc 7 ch.1 S56 — Nordland separatists

### Nielsa Klammer — Demagogue (canon ch.1 l.262-279)
- **Tough woman thick grey plaits, sealskin cap, toad-like face**. *« serious, hectoring tone of voice hardened years shouting at dockhands fur hunters. Touch fanaticism in her eye, but she's cynical and pragmatic enough »*.
- **Leader Neues Emskrank separatists**. Manipulée par Wasmeier *« mountain man »* disguise.
- **WS 39 BS 24 Int 34 WP 37 Fel 38** + Animosity (Middenheimers) Armour 2.
- Si cornered : surrender + public trial Middenheim *« could rally more support back in Nordland »*.

### Sepp Wurnhauser — Artillerist (canon ch.1 l.281-295)
- Imperial Second Fleet boatswain ex. Patriotic obsessionnel Sigmar+Manann+Nordland.
- **WS 35 BS 39 Dex 49 Ag 40** + Ranged (Blackpowder/Engineering) 49, Sail 49.
- **Operated Helstorm Rocket Battery** vs Sky Wolf dirigible.

### Hanne, Boris, Niklas, Mikhal (4 separatists)
- *« Assemblage of various discontents from Neues Emskrank who blame their misfortune on Middenheim rule »* (canon ch.1 l.299).
- **WS 36 BS 30** + Prejudice (Middenheimers) Armour 1.
- Hand Axes. Easily influenced. Quayside rhetoric Nielsa.

## Arc 7 ch.1 S56 — Dirigible crew

### Nabbi Nodrisson + Sindri Suttrisdottir — Dwarf Pilots Engineers (canon ch.1 l.131-144)
- 2 Dwarfs Middenheim's Dwarf Engineers' Guild. *« Don't like blundering manlings underfoot »*.
- **M3 WS 45 BS 49 Int 42** + Magic Resistance, Night Vision, Tinker.
- Pilote The Sky Wolf dirigible Middenheim → Karak Skygg → return.

## Arc 7 ch.3 S58 — Bearers of the Blood

### Konrad Metternich — Cleric-Captain Knights Fiery Heart
- Commander Sigmar knights défense Shining Rock attack (canon ch.3 l.224). Orders : *« All righteous men of Sigmar to me! We will not be mocked! »*.
- Profile Knight canon EiR Intro l.517 + Order Fiery Heart **Miracles Sigmar** Trait : Beacon Righteous Virtue, Sigmar's Fiery Hammer, Soulfire.

### Weregardt Schlupmann — Loup Blanc traître
- Sons of Ulric infiltrator. *« commands the second group of 20 Sons of Ulric attacking Sigmarite camp »*. Howls signal complices.
- *« +3 bonus combat extended Test if Character kills Weregardt Schlupmann »* (canon ch.3 l.277).

### Wolfgang Munchburger — Loup Blanc loyal
- *« We swore to stand by Ar-Ulric »* (canon ch.3 l.142). N'attaque pas, reste camp.

## Arc 7 ch.4 S59 — Castle Reikguard

### Preceptor Leberecht von Hardenburg — Chevalier Panthère
- *« Much decorated Knight Panther who strides into the room, snaps to attention and gives a brisk salute »* (canon ch.4 l.146).
- Annonce **Duke of Parravon agreed proposal** = Bretonnia alliance siège Blood Keep.

### Claudia Karll — Shallya Priestess
- *« Shallyan Priestess who has arrived from Altdorf to thank the Prince Héritier for his recent charitable work »* (canon ch.4 l.140).
- *« Why don't they? It's not just the money, your majesty; you have provided our patients with your time and your fellowship as few other noble personages do »*.

### Hans Bauer — Farmer Reikguard
- *« farmer who tends an estate in the shadow of the castle. Humble man dresses in a rough, beige shift, nervously holds a worn hat »* (canon ch.4 l.162).
- Thanks Wolfgang : *« we tried what you said and it seems to have worked for us, and now we're expecting our first child »*. Femme **Heidi**.

## Arc 7 ch.5 S60 — Défilé Altdorf

### Gravin Luciana von Eckstein — déjà mentionnée S57
- Solkanite secrète. Outburst von Eckstein-Bettie Greenhill. À Altdorf pose événement.

### Hildemar Kalb — High Steward Emmanuelle
- Emmanuelle entourage canon ch.5 l.108.

### Moritz Arbogast — Knight Blazing Sun
- Emmanuelle bodyguard. Chosen deliberately *« neither Sigmarite nor Ulrican »* (canon ch.5 l.108).

### Yabo Chao — Cathay ambassadrice
- Mentionnée canon S60 pavilion. Ambassador Cathay. Renvoie Yuridika *« sur les roses »* (résumé table).
- **Hildegarde Zimperlich** xenophobic warning : *« she's a foreign agent! »*.

### Helstorm Rocket Battery operators
- 7e Reikland Foot during parade.
- 2 **Steam Tanks** : **Conquérant** + **Indomptable** (canon défile ch.5 timeline).
- **The Fighting Cocks** halflings (Lupin Croupe) Altdorf garrison.

## Arc 7 ch.7 S62 — Conclave Volkshalle

### Ferdinand von Schilderheim + Emmaretta von Uder — Fishing rights dispute
- Reiklander + Middenlander arguing fishing rights river Reik. PJ asked opinion. Sigmar/Ulric undertone. (canon ch.7 l.141-148).

### Joachim von Aarberg + Reinhard von Mendenhall + Juergen Lasker von Drakberg — Card game
- *« Scarlet Empress »* card game. Drakberg accuses cheat → duel proposed. *« Average (+20) Charm Test reveals genuine friendship »* (canon ch.7 l.176).

## Arc 7 ch.9 — Flotilla refugees

### Caravan merchant ch.9 l.128-148
- 8 carts + outriders + 3 Ogres. Cathayan porcelain + Ind spices + Arabyan relics (Silk Road).
- News rumeurs Civil war + Emmanuelle troops + Marienburg.

### Mercenaries ch.9 l.127-145
- **Khypris Border Horse** = mounted freebooters Border Princes. May try recruit PJ. News Orcs Badlands.
- **Bloody Boris and his Brethren** (canon ch.12 l.81) : *« small group of mercenaries heading north looking for work. Boris is long dead, killed by the current leader, Kurt »* — Kurt + brigands.
- **Pilgrims** ch.12 l.85 : excited Pilgrims follow PJ telling everyone exploits. Constant moaning.

### Heidheinheim raid ch.9 l.286+
- Sudenland soldiers disguised Nuln (Threshers Fione Brecht).
- Heidheinheim Stirland bank Aver. Villageois massacrés.

## Arc 7 ch.10 — Black Fire Pass

### Alberecht Haessler — Sergeant Bergjaeger Mountainguard
- Patrol northern Black Fire Pass canon ch.10 l.42. Highly professional regiment.
- News : *« We'll be called back to Averland soon. Hear they'll need us protect province from insurrection or Ulricans »*.

### Father Otto Rotmund — Priest Temple Holy Founding
- *« cannot speak after he lost his tongue when tortured by Beastmen in the Drakwald. Tough veteran extremely pious »* (canon ch.10 l.123).
- 5-10 pilgrims serving temple in penance.

### Urd Flintbane — Dwarf warden Vithang Dum
- *« the dour warden »* canon ch.10 l.126. Travellers shelter horses + austere common room + basic victuals.

### Madcraw Clan ch.10 (Goblin tribe Lost Gorge)
- **Cruzzik Cacklespit** (déjà fiche existante — shaman leader)
- **Slik Moongobba** — *« right-hand gobbo, enjoys meting out discipline. Desperate to eat Purple Cap mushrooms »* (canon ch.10 l.404). Sneaky leader 2.
- **Globnak Mansplatta** — Skargobbo boss, *« hulking Goblin wears sleeveless robes, broken nose »* (canon ch.10 l.422). Choppa wielder.
- **Old Gruntlob** — *« elderly Goblin who oversees the runts. Twisted affection »* (canon ch.10 l.442).
- **Oddblat + Grikkle** — other shamans canon ch.10 l.470. Coven Cacklespit.

## Arc 7 ch.11 Caves of Chaos
- **Treacherous Herald** (canon ch.11 l.168-220) — Daemon Tzeentch Location 3. Already référencé dans Sheerargetru fiche.
- **Chaos Minotaur Lord** (canon ch.11 l.366) — Location 7 guardian.
- **Hetri Bittercrag — Dwarf Slave** : *« Hetri Bittercrag, Dwarf Slave »* canon HR l.5246-5249. **Femme naine** (canon ch.11 Karak Skygg lien Arc 6) — sa, brown curls, hazel eyes. Wanted explore Karak Skygg lost inhabitants when captured.

## Arc 7 ch.12 — Dwarf Chain transport
- **Gararoth** : Three-Axe Brewery Grenzstadt. Particularly taciturn Dwarf. Couvre PJ false half-barrels wagon.
- **Khardrif Inglepeak** : Dwarf Boatman. Western Clock Tower Averheim. Barge **The Pegasus** moored next **The Hidden Valley** inn. Hides PJ below deck (Weirdroot smell).
- **Durkan Orkisson** : Lengenfeld blacksmith specialising agricultural tools. Old even for Dwarf. *« moves slowly with aid two engraved sticks »*. Business run by grandson same name.
- **Captain Fimbur Dimzadson** : **The Iron Wind** sailing ship Nuln→Kemperbad. Tall tales travel adventure.
- **Able Kazriksson + Gurrin Ablesniz** : Kemperbad workshop. Ablesniz nephew tué (throat slit) par Cult Broken Fingers night attack.

### Martin Schmidt — Cult Broken Fingers leader
- *« Cult Broken Fingers numbers only five members, including Schmidt. Schmidt often receives visions (Holy Visions Talent) and his latest vision contained the Characters. He does not know why, but has decided they must die »* (canon ch.12 l.219).
- **WS 45 BS 45 WP 41** + Animosity (Kastor and Friends) + Ranged (Blunderbuss) +8 + Fast Shot + Holy Visions.
- **Splinter Main Pourpre Kemperbad**.

### Old Dirk — Swindler (ch.10 l.413)
- Skinny sheepdog **Captain** + worn pitchfork. *« Old Dirk is a swindler looking to make an easy shilling or two of travellers. The dog and pitchfork are stolen »*.

### Griswald Voit — Ulrican priest (ch.10 l.418)
- *« retired having accomplished nothing more than troop along one muddy road »*. Tension Sigmarite priest local. *« Wigbert pulls them aside »* (grandson). Use **Beate Moser profile** canon ch.10 l.426 (Hardy +4W, Bless Ulric, Holy Visions).

## Arc 7 ch.13 — Altdorf climax

### Sergeant Egon Pfeffer — Gate watch
- *« Watchmen 6 Soldiers led by Egon Pfeffer, a Sergeant »* canon ch.13 l.49. Restore order gate riot.
- **Challenging (+0) Leadership** PJ peuvent rally him *« brace up Sergeant Pfeifer »* → restore discipline subdual force.

### Captain Helstein — Company of Honour
- Captain Otto Helstein leads Altdorf Halberds Hammerpfad's barracks (canon ch.5 défilé timeline).

### Cult-Reiksguard False Honour Guard (9)
- **9 cultists** disguised Reiksguard honour guard reliquaire Volkshalle.
- **WS 50 BS 35 WP 55 W 17** + Armour 4 + Weapon (Halberd) +9. **Drilled, Riposte, Strike Mighty Blow**.
- **Main Pourpre Tattoo** detectable corpses search.
- **Iztak Graksk chant** 9 times pour summoning.
